items.titleEn: Go Inside Training ahead of final pre-season clash
items.summaryEn: Watch our Gunners in action before we take on Como at Emirates Stadium
bodyEn: We face Como 1907 at Emirates Stadium on Wednesday evening, and you can see how we've been preparing for the contest with Inside Training.
Tuesday's session saw us welcome back our England and Spain stars after their post-World Cup break, bringing our squad back to a full contingent.
Having been beaten 3-2 by Borussia Dortmund in the Emirates Cup, we'll be looking to get back to winning ways against Italian side Como and finish pre-season on a high.
Press play on the video at the top of the article to see what we got up to at the Sobha Realty Training Centre.
items.author: Connor Booth
items.titleZh: 季前收官战前，走进训练现场
items.summaryZh: 枪手主场迎战科莫前，观看训练备战。
bodyZh: 周三晚上，我们将在酋长球场迎战科莫1907，您可以通过《训练内幕》了解我们如何备战这场比赛。
在世界杯后的假期结束后，周二的训练迎来了英格兰和西班牙球星的回归，我们的阵容再次满员。
在酋长杯中2-3不敌多特蒙德之后，我们希望在对阵意大利球队科莫时重回胜利轨道，并以一场胜利结束季前赛。

items.titleEn: England and Spain stars return to training
items.summaryEn: We were back up to a full contingent in training ahead of our clash with Como
bodyEn: Our English and Spanish players returned to training for the first time since their involvement in the 2026 World Cup, and you can see how they got on with our latest training gallery.

Third-place finishers England and champions Spain boasted seven Gunners between their squads, but after a well-earned rest, they were back at the Sobha Realty Training Centre ahead of our pre-season clash with Italian side Como.
After a 3-2 defeat to Borussia Dortmund in an entertaining Emirates Cup tie, we'll be looking to finish pre-season on a high before we take on Manchester City in the Community Shield on Sunday.
Swipe through the gallery below, captured by club photographer Stuart MacFarlane, to see what our Gunners got up to in training:

items.titleEn: Supporters banned for abusive and discriminatory behaviour
items.summaryEn: We can confirm that nine supporters received football banning orders and stadium bans during the 2025/26 season for offences including assault, racism, antisemitism, homophobia and other abusive or intimidating behaviour
bodyEn: We can confirm that nine supporters received football banning orders and stadium bans during the 2025/26 season for offences including assault, racism, antisemitism, homophobia and other abusive or intimidating behaviour.
The supporters have each been handed football banning orders or stadium bans of between one and three years, during which they are prohibited from attending Arsenal matches.

We continue to assist police with a further 13 ongoing investigations covering alleged offences taking place at Arsenal matches or online, where individuals remain subject to the club's disciplinary processes pending the outcome of any case.
The bans are broken down as per the following offences:
Assault - 3Racism - 3Antisemitism – 1Homophobia – 1Antisocial behaviour - 1
Online abuse

Throughout the season, we continued to work with data science company Signify Group through its Threat Matrix service to identify, investigate and take action against online abuse targeting our players, coaches, staff and supporters.

During the 2025/26 season, we verified more than 17,700 posts and comments as abusive directed at individuals and accounts connected to us, a significant increase on the previous season. As a result of this work, 267 investigations were completed and 39 individuals positively identified and referred to us or other clubs for further action, of which nine cases were referred to law enforcement.

While not all identified individuals can be directly sanctioned, due to factors including jurisdiction and club affiliation, positive identification allows appropriate action to be considered by the relevant organisations and authorities where possible. Working closely with Signify, we continue to identify offenders, report abusive content to social media platforms and pursue action where individuals are found to have crossed the line.

Arsenal Chief Executive Officer, Richard Garlick, said, “This season gave us many moments to be proud of and showed once again the role football can play in bringing people together. The overwhelming majority of our supporters help make Arsenal a welcoming, inclusive and respectful place to be. Those standards are a big part of who we are, shaping the experience people have when they come to Arsenal, and how we represent our club around the world.

"Abuse and discrimination have no place at Arsenal, whether in our stadium or online. While these incidents involve a small minority, we will continue to take action when they happen, while doing everything we can to protect our players, staff, supporters and communities.”
Ongoing education

Education is an important part of our strategy for tackling abuse and discrimination. Individuals who have been banned are offered the chance to reduce the length of their punishment if they attend a one-to-one education programme run by Kick It Out.
Individuals who go through the programme discuss the impact of their behaviour on others and need to demonstrate a willingness to reflect and change their mindset moving forward.

We run inclusion workshops and events in our local community to support education on the topics of abuse and discrimination, while we also continue to lift the voices of our supporters and champion our communities through campaigns and initiatives that celebrate and champion diversity and inclusion.

If our supporters witness any form of offensive behaviour, they can report it using our anonymous ‘See Something, Say Something’ service by texting “Foul” to 67777 together with a description of the incident and location where it is taking place (such as the block, row and seat number).
This service protects supporters’ anonymity should they feel uncomfortable speaking to stewards publicly.
Abuse in the stadium or online can also be reported via our website.
items.author: Arsenal Media
items.titleZh: 球迷因辱骂和歧视行为遭禁赛
items.summaryZh: 确认2025/26赛季有9名球迷因袭击、种族主义、反犹太主义、恐同等辱骂或恐吓行为被下达足球禁赛令和球场禁令
bodyZh: 我们确认，在2025/26赛季，有9名球迷因袭击、种族主义、反犹太主义、恐同以及其他辱骂或恐吓行为而收到足球禁赛令和球场禁令。
这些球迷每人被处以一至三年的足球禁赛令或球场禁令，期间禁止参加阿森纳的比赛。
我们继续协助警方进行另外13项正在进行的调查，这些调查涉及据称在阿森纳比赛期间或网上发生的违法行为，相关个人在案件结果出来之前仍需接受俱乐部的纪律处分程序。
禁令按以下违法行为分类：
袭击 - 3、种族主义 - 3、反犹太主义 - 1、恐同 - 1、反社会行为 - 1
网络辱骂
整个赛季，我们继续与数据科学公司Signify Group合作，通过其Threat Matrix服务来识别、调查和打击针对我们球员、教练、工作人员和球迷的网络辱骂行为。
在2025/26赛季，我们核实了超过17,700条帖子和评论是针对与我们相关的个人和账户的辱骂内容，较上赛季显著增加。通过这项工作，完成了267项调查，并确定39名个人的身份，将其移交给我们或其他俱乐部作进一步处理，其中9起案件已移交执法部门。
虽然不是所有被确认身份的个人都能直接受到制裁（原因包括管辖权和俱乐部隶属关系等因素），但积极的身份确认允许相关组织和机构在可能的情况下考虑采取适当行动。我们与Signify密切合作，继续识别违规者，向社交媒体平台举报辱骂内容，并对发现越界的个人采取行动。
阿森纳首席执行官Richard Garlick表示：“本赛季给了我们许多值得骄傲的时刻，并再次展示了足球在将人们聚集在一起方面所发挥的作用。绝大多数球迷帮助阿森纳成为一个热情、包容和尊重的地方。这些标准是我们身份的重要组成部分，塑造了人们来到阿森纳时的体验，以及我们在世界各地代表俱乐部的方式。”
"辱骂和歧视在阿森纳没有立足之地，无论是在我们的球场还是在网上。虽然这些事件涉及少数人，但我们将继续在事件发生时采取行动，同时尽我们所能保护我们的球员、工作人员、支持者和社区。”
持续教育
教育是我们打击辱骂和歧视策略的重要组成部分。被禁赛的个人如果参加由Kick It Out组织的一对一教育项目，就有机会缩短处罚期。
参加该项目的个人将讨论其行为对他人的影响，并需要表现出反思和改变心态的意愿。
我们在当地社区开展包容性讲习班和活动，以支持有关辱骂和歧视主题的教育，同时我们继续通过庆祝和倡导多元化和包容性的活动和倡议，提升支持者的声音，为我们的社区发声。
如果我们的球迷目睹任何形式的冒犯性行为，可以使用我们的匿名“看见就说”（See Something, Say Something）服务进行举报，发送短信“Foul”到67777，并附上事件描述和发生地点（如看台、排和座位号）。
如果支持者不愿意公开与管理员交谈，这项服务可以保护他们的匿名性。
球场内或网上的辱骂行为也可以通过我们的网站举报。

items.summaryEn: Jenna Nighswonger has completed a permanent move to Bay FC in the National Women’s Soccer League in the United States.
bodyEn: Jenna Nighswonger has completed a permanent move to Bay FC in the National Women’s Soccer League in the United States.
The 25-year-old American full-back departs us having made six first team appearances.
Jenna joined us in January 2025 from US side Gotham FC and made her debut in our FA Cup fifth round win over London City Lionesses at Meadow Park on 9 February 2025.
In January 2026, Jenna joined WSL side Aston Villa for the remainder of the 2025/26 season. She made eight appearances during her time with The Villans.
Everyone at Arsenal would like to thank Jenna for her contribution and we wish her the best of luck in her next chapter.

items.titleZh: 詹娜·奈斯旺格离开阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 詹娜·奈斯旺格完成永久转会，加盟美国国家女子足球联赛的湾FC。
bodyZh: 詹娜·奈斯旺格完成永久转会，加盟美国国家女子足球联赛的湾FC。
这位25岁的美国边后卫离队，她曾为一线队出场6次。
詹娜于2025年1月从美国哥谭FC加盟我们，并在2025年2月9日于草地公园对阵伦敦城雌狮的足总杯第五轮胜利中完成首秀。
2026年1月，詹娜加盟女子超级联赛球队阿斯顿维拉，效力至2025/26赛季剩余时间。她在维拉期间出场8次。
阿森纳全体人员感谢詹娜的贡献，并祝愿她在新的篇章中一切顺利。

items.titleEn: Remembering the time we played France in a friendly
items.summaryEn: Find out the details about when we played France in a friendly on Valentine's Day
bodyEn: Seven years before Arsene Wenger’s arrival as manager sparked what was dubbed the ‘French revolution’ at Highbury, George Graham’s Arsenal played a friendly match in N5 against the French national team on Valentine’s Day in February 1989.

The match came about because the French, semi-finalists at both the 1982 and 1986 World Cups, had made a poor start to their qualification matches for the 1990 tournament. Michel Platini’s men, who’d failed to qualify for the 1988 European Championships, beat Norway 1-0 in their first qualifier thanks to an 84th-minute penalty from Jean-Pierre Papin but could only draw in Cyprus before losing to Yugoslavia.
With a tough-looking match approaching against Scotland at Hampden Park, Platini wanted his talented but inconsistent players to experience what it was like to play a British side on away turf.

Platini opted against a match with Tottenham, as he believed their style was ‘too continental.’ Arsenal, on the other hand, with their high-press style (not that such a phrase yet existed in the late ‘80s) and physical approach, fitted the bill. ‘Arsenal are very British and will be no less difficult to play than Scotland,’ Platini said.

The match was perfectly timed. Although neck and neck with Liverpool in the title race, Arsenal were out of both domestic cups. With no European matches in the offing due to the ban on English clubs competing in Europe following the Heysel Disaster in 1985, there was a gap in their midweek diary.

In the programme for the game, which featured Platini on the front cover, Graham wrote "‘Tonight’s game will provide valuable experience for many of our team, who meet European opposition very rarely because of the Euro ban on English clubs.’ Vice chairman David Dein spoke of his hope for ‘a speedy return to European competition."

The match was screened live on French TV, and a 21,875 crowd turned up in N5 to watch the likes of goalkeeper Joël Bats, defender Laurent Blanc and Papin strut their stuff. Eric Cantona, who’d make such an impression on the English game in the ‘90s, was suspended.

The game livened up in the second half, after George Graham made two substitutions. Martin Hayes, no longer a first team regular, replaced Brian Marwood and gave Arsenal the lead after 60 minutes with a brilliant finish from just inside the area.

Winger Perry Groves came on for David Rocastle, burst down Arsenal’s right and crossed for Alan Smith to double Arsenal’s lead in the 74th minute. Platini was magnanimous in defeat, explaining: ‘On this form, Arsenal look a better team than England. They were very good.’
The result at Hampden Park didn’t go France’s way either, with two Mo Johnston goals giving the hosts a win.

The 2-0 victory proved decisive, with Scotland pipping France to a place at Italia ’90. George Graham’s side had taken the friendly with France seriously, and he’d picked the same side which had beaten Millwall 2-1 a few days earlier.
By season’s end they’d lift the title, and a decade later, Arsenal’s French stars Patrick Vieira and Emmanuel Petit would combine to help France lift their first World Cup in Paris.
items.author: Jon Spurling
items.titleZh: 回忆我们与法国队的友谊赛
items.summaryZh: 了解我们在情人节与法国队进行友谊赛的细节。
bodyZh: 在阿尔塞纳·温格到来引发海布里所谓“法国革命”的七年前，1989年情人节，乔治·格雷厄姆执教的阿森纳在N5区与法国国家队进行了一场友谊赛。
这场比赛源于法国队——1982年和1986年世界杯半决赛球队——在1990年世界杯预选赛中开局不佳。米歇尔·普拉蒂尼的球队未能晋级1988年欧洲杯，在首场预选赛中凭借让-皮埃尔·帕潘第84分钟的点球1-0战胜挪威，但随后在塞浦路斯只取得平局，又输给了南斯拉夫。
由于即将在汉普顿公园对阵苏格兰队，比赛形势严峻，普拉蒂尼希望他那些有天赋但不稳定的球员体验一下在客场对阵英国球队的感觉。
普拉蒂尼选择不与托特纳姆热刺比赛，因为他认为他们的风格“过于欧陆化”。而阿森纳的高压逼抢风格（尽管80年代末还没有这种说法）和身体对抗符合要求。普拉蒂尼说：“阿森纳非常英式，踢起来不会比苏格兰更容易。”
比赛时机恰到好处。尽管阿森纳在联赛冠军争夺中与利物浦并驾齐驱，但已双双退出国内杯赛。由于1985年海塞尔惨案后英格兰俱乐部被禁止参加欧洲赛事，他们周中的日程出现了空档。
在那场以普拉蒂尼为封面的比赛节目中，格雷厄姆写道：“今晚的比赛将为我们的许多球员提供宝贵的经验，由于欧洲禁令，他们很少遇到欧洲对手。”副主席大卫·戴恩则表达了他对‘尽快重返欧洲赛场’的希望。
这场比赛在法国电视台进行了直播，21875名观众来到N5区观看门将若埃尔·巴茨、后卫洛朗·布兰克和帕潘等人的表演。埃里克·坎通纳——这位将在90年代给英格兰足球留下深刻印象的球员——当时被禁赛。
下半场，乔治·格雷厄姆做出了两次换人，比赛变得活跃起来。不再是常规首发的马丁·海耶斯替换了布莱恩·马伍德，并在第60分钟在禁区边缘精彩破门，为阿森纳取得领先。
边锋佩里·格罗夫斯换下大卫·罗卡斯特，沿阿森纳右路突破后传中，艾伦·史密斯在第74分钟将阿森纳的领先优势扩大为两球。普拉蒂尼对失利表现大度，解释说：“以这种状态，阿森纳看起来比英格兰队更强。他们非常出色。”
汉普顿公园的结果对法国队也不利，莫·约翰斯顿的两个进球让主队获胜。
这场2-0的胜利被证明是决定性的，苏格兰挤掉法国队，获得了1990年意大利世界杯的参赛资格。乔治·格雷厄姆的球队认真对待了与法国的友谊赛，他派出了与几天前2-1击败米尔沃尔时相同的阵容。
赛季结束时，他们举起了冠军奖杯。十年后，阿森纳的法国球星帕特里克·维埃拉和埃马纽埃尔·佩蒂特联手帮助法国队在巴黎捧起了他们的第一座世界杯冠军。

items.titleEn: FPL Focus: Key info for newcomers and veterans
items.summaryEn: Build an invincible Fantasy squad now!
bodyEn: Having opened last week for the 2026/27 season, Fantasy Premier League squads have been drafted by millions of hopefuls across the globe.
Following the game’s official relaunch last Thursday, managers far and wide have provisionally selected their 15-man squads with a £100million budget to strive for glory.
KEY CHANGES FOR 2026/27

With many competitors having racked up experience in the FPL world over recent seasons, here are a few key alterations the Premier League have tweaked this summer ahead of the new season kick-off when we host Coventry City on Friday, August 21.

Starting with positional changes, Myles Lewis-Skelly (£5.5m) is one of 11 players whose in-game positions have been moved ahead of the new campaign. Our No. 49’s terrific end to 2025/26 in the centre of the park have seen him moved into a default midfield slot on FPL, in place of his previous defensive berth.

A breakout season as a ‘deep-lying’ attacker for Bournemouth last term, Eli Junior Kroupi (£7.5m) has surprisingly been reinstalled as a midfielder in Fantasy football this term. With his price having also risen by a whole £3.0m since this time last year, FPL have recognised the youngster’s popularity - particularly now any goal he scores will register his owners five points rather than just four.

Going the opposite way is Manchester City’s Omar Marmoush (£7.0m), now in as a forward rather than a midfielder following his attacking deployment last year, while Brighton’s Mats Wieffer (£5.0m) will now be eligible for clean sheet points having seen his usual defensive position recognised. Manchester United’s Patrick Dorgu (£6.0m) will now be available as a midfielder having played as an effective winger under boss Michael Carrick.

The bonus points system will also change, having relied on a behind-the-scenes formula to decide the handouts of up to three points for the best-performing players in any given match. This also applies to defensive contributions (DefCon), which single-handedly added a wealth of points to top-performing defenders and midfielders and increased many teams’ values in its inaugural season.
MASTERING THE BENEFITS

Continuing with the walkthrough of key changes to FPL this season, there are several features which could pay dividends for managers - both those just starting out, and those who have been part of the Fantasy community for decades.

For relative newcomers or those requiring a helping hand when selecting their squad this summer, a new option has been freshly introduced in which managers can answer some quickfire questions on what they are most actively seeking in their team to begin the season.

A recommended squad will then be delivered, and can be adapted with unlimited changes until the Gameweek 1 deadline on Friday, August 21, at 6:30pm. More experienced managers or those comfortable with building from scratch can bypass this suggestion, but it provides a more effective option than the long-standing squad randomiser.

Another new feature allows managers to keep their finger right on the pulse throughout the action, with live updates to mini-league rankings. While the most skilled in the worldwide community will seek the world rankings, mini-leagues make up a considerable majority of the stakes among friends, families and colleagues and can now be tracked - even including projected player bonus points - as every ball is kicked.

For a significant time, existing features such as the Fixture Difficulty Rating (FDR) algorithm have acted as a huge assistance when strategising our teams across future Gameweeks. This can ensure your squad is well-structured to more regularly take on favourable opponents, and that transfers can be made within budget at the most efficient times.

You can now view your squad alongside the FDR to more easily make the changes you need, while the incoming Price Change Predictor (PCP) will prove critical when looking to plan transfers, remain within the £100m threshold and maximise your squad value.

The final major change worth mentioning at this stage is the later ‘lockdown’ as described by the Premier League. This means FPL squad points totals will not be finalised until 9am UK time the following day after a Gameweek’s final matchday. For instance, should there be a Monday evening match to round off a Gameweek, the succeeding Tuesday will be the period to check your round total. Having previously cut off an hour after the final whistle on the final Gameweek fixture, this change allows more accuracy in the scoring system, which is calculated alongside Opta.

As referred to in last week’s edition of FPL Focus, the major aspect of the game to remain the same this summer is your selection of chips. The iconic quartet of Wildcard, Bench Boost, Triple Captain and Free Hit will all be available twice each - one use for each before the Gameweek 19 deadline, and likewise after the turn of the year. Previous initiatives including the rather spontaneous 2024/25 ‘Assistant Manager’ chip will again be absent.
RAYA AND GABI LEAD THE WAY
While there will be no points on the board for over three weeks yet, the indications for the most popular 2026/27 FPL starters are clear for all to see.

The squad selection percentages are now live on the Premier League’s Fantasy statistics page, and there has been a significant tilt towards several of our Gunners following their title-winning totals last season.

Having scooped another Golden Glove and led the way for FPL goalkeepers in 2025/26, David Raya has been selected by just shy of 30% of managers, even despite his starting price of £6.0m which reflects his clean sheet record.

Having become the third-most-expensive defender in Fantasy history, Gabriel (£8.0m) is certainly not putting off many with his premium fee, having been included in 25.3% of provisional line-ups after smashing the 200-point milestone last time out. David and Big Gabi are closely followed by Declan Rice (£7.5m), his impact at both ends of the pitch last season making him a must-have for 22% of managers.

Following the medical update regarding William Saliba (£6.0m) last week, a massively popular pick of late has been Cristhian Mosquera (£5.5m). Our young Spaniard enjoyed a very impressive debut campaign in England, ending with a Premier League winner’s medal and a start in the Champions League final, and his name flashes up in 16.8% of squads so far.

Keep your eyes peeled for our next edition of FPL Focus, where we continue to count down to that first kick back at Emirates Stadium next month against Coventry City, when your Fantasy team must be firmly locked in!
items.author: Dan Godfrey
items.titleZh: FPL焦点：新老玩家必看关键信息
items.summaryZh: 打造无敌梦幻阵容，尽在本指南！
bodyZh: 上周，2026/27赛季梦幻英超已开启，全球数百万玩家已组建了他们的梦幻阵容。
在上周四游戏正式重启后，各地经理人纷纷使用1亿英镑预算初步选定了他们的15人阵容，以争夺荣耀。
2026/27赛季主要变化
许多竞争者在过去几个赛季中积累了FPL经验，以下是英超联盟在8月21日（周五）我们主场迎战考文垂城的新赛季开球前，于今夏做出的一些关键调整。
从位置变化开始，迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利（550万英镑）是季前调整位置的11名球员之一。我们的49号在2025/26赛季末在中场的出色表现，使他在FPL中的默认位置从中场变为中场（此前为后卫）。
伊莱·朱尼尔·克鲁皮（750万英镑）上赛季在伯恩茅斯作为“拖后”攻击手表现出色，本赛季在梦幻足球中被重新设定为中场。他的价格也比去年同期上涨了整整300万英镑，FPL认可了这位年轻球员的受欢迎程度——尤其是现在他每进一球将为拥有者带来5分而非4分。
曼城的奥马尔·马尔穆什（700万英镑）则相反，经过上赛季的进攻部署后，他现在被列为前锋而非中场。而布莱顿的马茨·维弗（500万英镑）现在将因后卫位置而获得零封积分。曼联的帕特里克·多尔古（600万英镑）在迈克尔·卡里克麾下担任高效边锋后，现在被列为中场。
奖励积分系统也将改变，此前依赖幕后公式决定每场最佳球员最多3分的分配。这也适用于防守贡献（DefCon），该机制在首个赛季中为顶级后卫和中场增加了大量积分，并提升了许多球队的价值。
掌握优势
继续上赛季FPL关键变化的讲解，有几项功能可以为经理人带来回报——无论是新手还是参与梦幻社区数十年的老玩家。
对于相对新手或本赛季夏天选队时需要帮助的人，新引入了一个选项：经理人可以快速回答几个问题，表明他们在赛季开始时最希望球队具备哪些特质。
然后会提供推荐阵容，并可以在8月21日（周五）下午6:30的第一周截止前无限次修改。经验丰富或自信从头建队的经理人可以跳过此建议，但它比长期的随机阵容功能更有效。
另一项新功能让经理人即时了解比赛动态，包括小联盟排名的实时更新。虽然全球社区中最熟练的玩家会追逐世界排名，但小联盟在朋友、家人和同事之间占据绝大多数竞争，现在可以实时跟踪——甚至包括预测的球员奖励积分——随着每一次触球而更新。
长期以来，赛程难度评级（FDR）算法等现有功能在规划未来比赛周阵容时提供了巨大帮助。这可以确保你的阵容结构合理，更常对阵有利对手，并在最有效的时间在预算内完成转会。
你现在可以结合FDR查看阵容，更轻松地进行所需调整，而即将推出的价格变化预测器（PCP）在规划转会、保持1亿英镑预算内并最大化阵容价值方面至关重要。
现阶段值得一提的最后一个主要变化是英超联盟描述的“锁定”时间稍晚。这意味着FPL阵容积分将在比赛周最后比赛日结束后的第二天英国时间上午9点才最终确定。例如，如果周一晚上有一场比赛结束一个比赛周，那么周二将是查看你本轮积分的时段。此前是在最后一场比赛终场哨响后一小时截止，这一变化使积分系统更准确，该系统与Opta协同计算。
正如上周FPL焦点中提到的，今夏游戏保持不变的主要方面是你的筹码选择。标志性的四张筹码：野卡、替补增益、三倍队长和自由击球，每张均可用两次——在第19周截止前各一次，新年过后各一次。此前包括2024/25赛季相当随意的“助理经理”筹码等举措将再次缺席。
拉亚和加布里埃尔领跑
虽然还有三周多才计分，但哪些球员将成为2026/27赛季FPL最热门首发的迹象已很明朗。
阵容选择百分比现已发布在英超梦幻统计页面上，有显著倾向选择我们几位枪手，因为上赛季他们赢得了冠军。
大卫·拉亚再次获得金手套，并在2025/26赛季FPL门将中遥遥领先，尽管起价为600万英镑，但已有近30%的经理人选择了他，这反映了他出色的零封记录。
加布里埃尔（800万英镑）成为梦幻历史上第三贵的后卫，他的高价并没有让很多人望而却步，因为他上赛季突破了200分大关，出现在25.3%的初步阵容中。大卫和加布里埃尔紧随其后的是德克兰·赖斯（750万英镑），他上赛季在攻防两端的贡献使他成为22%经理人的必选。
在上周威廉·萨利巴（600万英镑）的医疗更新之后，近期非常受欢迎的选择是克里斯蒂安·莫斯克拉（550万英镑）。我们年轻的西班牙人在英格兰的首个赛季表现令人印象深刻，最终赢得英超冠军奖牌并在欧冠决赛首发，迄今为止他的名字出现在16.8%的阵容中。
请密切关注我们下一版FPL焦点，我们继续倒计时下个月在酋长球场对阵考文垂城的首次开球，届时你的梦幻球队必须锁定！

bodyEn: From Thierry Henry's solo strike to Declan Rice's free-kick masterclass, we've netted a host of stunning strikes against La Liga opposition down the years.

We've been enjoying netbusters against Spanish sides for over 20 years and as we gear up to face Atletico de Madrid in the Champions League in 2025/26, we've put togehter some of the very best for you to savour.
Press play on the video above now to enjoy a hosts of strikes!
